title: Marbles
body:
"I'm literally losing my marbles over this! They roll everywhere, ugh."

Description

Marbles can be purchased at Alan's AutoLogistics for $150. When unboxed, marbles reveal a variety of sizes and colors. Each time you open a box, a different variant will be revealed.

There are 3 sizes and 10 colors: Quill grey, black, Tr, Red, Bright green, Royal blue, Med. bluish green, Bright orange, Royal purple, pink and Curry.

It's also possible to get a gold marble. The exact chance is 1/1,000.

Trivia

Marble's Box still has no decal on it.
